info.title: Den API
info.description: M3 REST API. Cookie-authenticated writes require Origin and X-CSRF-Token. CLI and agents use bearer authentication. Entity IDs are ULIDs; background image IDs are opaque SHA-256 content IDs.

post.description: Create a 45-second DM invitation after joining its call. The active caller's retries return the same generation without re-ringing. Accepted media survives the ringing deadline.

post.description: First answer wins per recipient account. Matching answer UUID and credential retries return state; another credential/answer returns answered_elsewhere. Fetch media separately through the existing token endpoint. An answer that never joins is cleared after a 20-second grace only when LiveKit confirms no connection for that recipient account; an outage preserves it.

post.description: Caller-only cancellation before any acceptance. A cancelled generation retries with 204; active or other terminal generations return 409. Never disconnects media.

post.description: Decline for your recipient account. Legacy caller/expiry matching remains supported; include invitation_id to identify the exact generation. Accepted answers cannot be declined.

101.description: Event stream; first event requires resync

default.description: API error; invalid input, authentication, permissions, conflict, throttling or storage failure

id.description: Opaque SHA-256 content ID. Changes when the image bytes change.

CallInvitation.description:
An invitation expires 45 seconds after creation. Repeated creation by the
same caller returns the existing invitation without notifying again.

expires_at.description: Unix time in seconds. Clients must dismiss an unanswered invitation then.

member_ids.description: Explicit DM participants. Text and voice channels are visible to all users.

notification_count.description: Unread messages eligible under current preferences, excluding own messages.

task_id.description: Opaque job identity supplied by a runner, scoped to this author and channel.

thread_id.description:
Explicit thread destination. Absent is not by itself a main-conversation
send: reply_to or task_id may still place the message in a thread.

user_id.description: Omit for self; a human may also mint credentials for a bot they own.

DeclineCallInvitation.description:
Identify the invitation being declined so a delayed request cannot dismiss
a newer call in the same DM.

Device.description: Registration receipt. Tokens are deliberately omitted from responses.

oneOf.description: `jam` is absent when the Jam ended. Gated behind `?jam=true` on `/ws`.

jam.description: A Spotify Jam someone started for a room. Pinned, not a message.

joined_user_ids.description:
Den members who pressed Join. Spotify never reports who is listening, so
this is a count of Den clicks and nothing more.

sampled_at.description: Server clock for `progress_ms`, Unix milliseconds. Mirrors `MusicQueue::updated_at`.

oneOf.description: Only other DM members with a pending, unexpired invitation receive this.
Reconnect or lag requires refetching channel state, presence, and calls. No replay is promised.

Shared thread metadata. Authorized by the parent channel, like any other
channel event. New variants go here, last, so no existing variant moves.
One user's own thread position. Never delivered to anybody else.

Event.description: Every event pushed over the WebSocket stream. The CLI's `tail` prints these.

session_ids.description: Retained PTYs. None identifies a legacy host, not an empty inventory.

HostFrame.description:
UTF-8 JSON inside binary WebSocket messages. Byte fields contain octets.
Open is idempotent: an existing PTY sends its recent scrollback and resizes.

IncomingVoipCall.description:
Generated projection of the incoming VoIP custom fields, excluding aps/type.
Report these to CallKit immediately, before any network request.

fetch_ticket.description: One-use state-only read capability, never a media or login credential.

Jam.description: A Spotify Jam someone started for a room. Pinned, not a message.

joined_user_ids.description:
Den members who pressed Join. Spotify never reports who is listening, so
this is a count of Den clicks and nothing more.

sampled_at.description: Server clock for `progress_ms`, Unix milliseconds. Mirrors `MusicQueue::updated_at`.

roots_only.description:
Legacy false marks the flat conversation through this message. New clients
send true for the main timeline and read threads at the thread endpoint.

MarkThreadRead.description:
Advances one thread's own read position. A thread read never moves the main
conversation's position, and reading does not by itself follow the thread.

thread.description:
Shared thread metadata. Deliberately free of per-user state so one payload can
be broadcast to every member who can see the parent channel.

resolved_at.description: Both resolution fields are set together or not at all.

root_message_id.description: The message the conversation hangs off. It stays in the main conversation.

title.description: A snapshot inferred at creation. Editing the root never rewrites it.

thread_id.description: Set on replies. Roots and main-conversation messages leave it absent.

roots_only.description: True returns the main conversation only. Absent or false is the legacy flat list.

participant_id.description: Stable LiveKit participant identity; use the regular participant volume control.

updated_at.description: Server time for the progress position, in Unix milliseconds.

ObjectSummary.description: Document records keyed by record id. The server treats record contents as opaque.

thread_id.description:
Conversation context, so a task's first card can land with the work that
caused it. The object still belongs to its message; this is not a second
thread assignment.

emoji.description: Exactly one extended grapheme cluster when set.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds; expired statuses are served as absent.

ticket.description: One-use read capability. Never place in a URL or log.

display_name.description:
What people see. Falls back to the username when absent, so older
clients that predate the field still register.

client_id.description: Installation UUID; required for PushKit, optional for legacy alert clients.

environment.description: Defaults to DEN_APNS_ENV. Explicit sandbox and production route independently.

token.description: APNs token encoded as hexadecimal. Do not log or expose this credential.

RoomJam.description:
A room's Jam, or none. Wrapped rather than returned as a bare nullable
object, because Apple's Swift generator rejects a standalone null branch in
`oneOf`. Mirrors the shape of `Event::JamUpdated`.

jam.description: A Spotify Jam someone started for a room. Pinned, not a message.

joined_user_ids.description:
Den members who pressed Join. Spotify never reports who is listening, so
this is a count of Den clicks and nothing more.

sampled_at.description: Server clock for `progress_ms`, Unix milliseconds. Mirrors `MusicQueue::updated_at`.

account_name.description: Spotify display name, for "Connected as …". Absent unless connected.

expires_at.description:
Unix seconds when the refresh token is assumed dead, so the UI can warn
before the cliff. Advisory: a rejection from Spotify is authoritative.

url.description: Send the browser here. The code comes back to `/spotify/callback`.

SpotifyConnection.description: Whether a user's Spotify account is attached to Den, and whether it still works.

sampled_at.description: Server clock for `progress_ms`, Unix milliseconds. Mirrors `MusicQueue::updated_at`.

emoji.description: Exactly one extended grapheme cluster when set.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds; expired statuses are served as absent.

ThreadQuery.description:
Thread IDs are creation-ordered ULIDs, so listing pages by ID like the other lists.
Filters combine: a thread must satisfy every one that is present.

resolved.description: Absent lists every thread; false lists the open strip; true lists resolved history.

unread_only.description:
True lists only threads contributing unread activity to this caller's channel
total. Absent or false applies no unread filter.

ThreadReadState.description: One user's position in one thread. Following changes unread accounting, never access.

notification_count.description: Unread replies eligible under current preferences, excluding own messages.

ThreadSummary.description:
Shared thread metadata. Deliberately free of per-user state so one payload can
be broadcast to every member who can see the parent channel.

resolved_at.description: Both resolution fields are set together or not at all.

root_message_id.description: The message the conversation hangs off. It stays in the main conversation.

title.description: A snapshot inferred at creation. Editing the root never rewrites it.

UpdateThread.description: Rename, resolve or reopen. An omitted field is left unchanged.

thumbnail_url.description: Authenticated PNG preview, at most 512 by 512. None when unavailable.

bot.description: True when this identity was created for an agent rather than a person.

emoji.description: Exactly one extended grapheme cluster when set.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds; expired statuses are served as absent.

VoicePreferences.description: PUT merges device entries, preserving other devices on the account.

WsTicket.description: A short-lived, single-use credential for a native client's WebSocket upgrade.
